variables.name: X_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID
variables.title: X OAuth 2.0 Client ID
variables.description: Client ID under 'OAuth 2.0 Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys & Tokens.

variables.name: X_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.title: X OAuth 2.0 Client Secret
variables.description: Client Secret under 'OAuth 2.0 Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys & Tokens (configure App Type as 'Web App, Automated App or Bot').
